CLAIM — session `757f0dc0-5dae-51d7-9053-c15c57ebfe3b`(skills 席),branch `claude/issue-11253-smoke-unscoped-pin`。维护者发版现场裁决「A:先修烟测再发」,阻塞 17.2.0,立卡即派发。

```json
{
  "issue": 11253,
  "status": "done",
  "branch": "claude/issue-11253-smoke-unscoped-pin",
  "pr": "https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/11257",
  "premise_still_valid": true,
  "summary": "The defect and its release impact are confirmed exactly as the card describes; one mechanism correction. The pin set was NOT built from an @objectstack/* scope glob — publish-smoke-pack.mjs already derived from `private !== true`. The hole was a hand-written by-name exclusion on top of that derivation (`const EXCLUDE = new Set(['create-objectstack'])`), whose stated rationale ('no @objectstack/* manifest depends on it') expired when @objectstack/cli took a dependency on the scaffolder. A scope filter DID exist in the second site the card named: the registry-leak assertion in publish-smoke.sh grepped `'@objectstack/[^'@]+@[0-9]`, so it was blind in precisely the case it existed to catch — the failed run got `ok — 0 leaks` and then died inside pnpm 200 lines later. Both are fixed: the set is now the publishable population with no filter/exclusion/hand list, `assertPinSetTotal` re-checks pin set == publishable set in BOTH directions at the derivation site naming offenders, and the leak guard drives off the override map's own names. A --self-test is wired as `check:publish-smoke-pin` in lint.yml so the release-path assertion reddens on the PR that breaks it rather than on the operator's release run. Source of truth argued in the PR body: the workspace, because the .changeset fixed group is a derived declaration that check-changeset-fixed.mjs keeps honest — measured identical (69 == 69) on this branch.",
  "tests": "All at final commit c2fc2d9e (gate union run AFTER the last commit). REPRODUCTION: current construction yields 68 members, create-objectstack absent; after the fix 69, present — and it is the ONLY unscoped publishable package, which is why no all-@ fixture could catch it. FULL SMOKE RAN LOCALLY AND PASSED — `bash scripts/publish-smoke.sh` (pack mode) after building the closure: `Packing 69 publishable package(s)`, `wrote .../pnpm-workspace.yaml (69 overrides)` including `'create-objectstack': 'file:.../create-objectstack-17.1.0.tgz'`, new guard `ok — 58/69 pinned packages resolved from tarballs, 0 registry leaks`, auth + REST CRUD probes 200/201, `== Publish smoke passed (pack mode)`. No leg was left to CI. ISOLATED INSTALL LEG with the real tarballs, two throwaway projects differing only in the pin: OLD (68) lockfile reads `create-objectstack@17.1.0:` = npm REGISTRY; NEW (69) reads `create-objectstack@file:../tarballs/create-objectstack-17.1.0.tgz` = candidate tarball. Packed cli manifest confirms the trigger: `create-objectstack dep: \"17.1.0\"` (pnpm pack rewrites workspace:* to a concrete version). GUARD HALF against that same leaking lockfile: OLD scope grep returned ok (blind); NEW guard EXIT=1 naming `create-objectstack@17.1.0`. ABLATION (no build/dist involved — the script is executed directly, not resolved through a package `exports`, so no rebuild leg applies; each mutation was confirmed ON DISK by grepping for BOTH the injected and the removed text before running, not by the editor's exit code): restoring the by-name exclusion turned case 1 red (`unscoped public package dropped from the set: [\"@objectstack/cli\"]`); neutering the equality branch turned cases 2 and 3 red (`a pin set missing a publishable member was accepted`). RESTORE LEG re-verified with the mutation proven absent (grep count 0) and `SELF-TEST PASSED (4 cases)`; the ablation script carried a `trap ... EXIT INT TERM` restore. GATES: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no hand-fed paths) derived 17 families from the real change set; all 17 green. check:type-check-debt initially refused with `--re-measure cannot run: 56 workspace dependenc(ies) ... have no built type entry point on disk`, so the closure was built as lint.yml does (turbo build, `70 successful, 70 total`) and it then printed `check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK — 33 ledger entr(ies) re-measured, 1897 raw tsc error(s) total, none above its recorded number` (its lowering hints are pre-existing, untouched by this diff). check:nul-bytes `OK (scanned 6527 text file(s) ... no raw ASCII control bytes)` plus a manual control-byte scan of the five changed files (no hits). Every verdict above is quoted from the gate's own printed line, never a bare $?; heavy steps ran through scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh. GOVERNED-MERGES: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the final five-path file list → `0 of 5 path(s) hit the register` / `NOT governed — ordinary queue landing applies`; its --self-test passed 119 assertions. CHANGESET: none — `skip-changeset` applied and CONFIRMED BY READ-BACK (labels now ci/cd, dependencies, size/m, skip-changeset); nothing here ships to npm.",
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": []
}
```

**For the release operator (also in the PR body):** merging does **not** start a smoke run — `publish-smoke.yml` has only `schedule` (weekly registry canary) and `workflow_dispatch`. After this merges, open [publish-smoke.yml](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/workflows/publish-smoke.yml) → **Run workflow** → branch `main` → Run. That dispatch runs the `pack-smoke` job (`if: github.event_name != 'schedule'`), the leg that was failing.
